description: Land Acquisition - Rambukpotha, Badulla D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act for the University of Uva Wellassa. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (Block numbers, extent, location details, current use, and claimants) and follows the statutory process for land acquisition notices. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
